_note: Effort as the fleet recorded it. cost_usd is null on every problem: the model gateway returns 0.0 for models it has no price for, and a zero here would be a cost nobody measured. Token counts are real.

trajectory._note: Measured on GPUs 1-7 under seven-way agent load, so these are trajectory values, not scores. The authoritative numbers are the idle-GPU-0 re-times in scored.json.
